implementation_backlog.verification: Official July desktop documentation lists only macOS and Windows.

implementation_backlog.issue: Computer Use and desktop dictation are explicitly unavailable; Quick Entry differs on Wayland.
implementation_backlog.verification: Linux beta documentation states the gaps directly.
implementation_backlog.recommendation: Hide unsupported controls, display platform explanation, and add X11/Wayland capability checks.

implementation_backlog.issue: Remote tasks continue when desktop closes but lose local file/browser/computer access.
implementation_backlog.verification: Cowork parity help documents the open-desktop requirement.
implementation_backlog.recommendation: Add host-online, capability-degraded, and reconnect states to every remote task view.

implementation_backlog.issue: Some cloud Work may not appear in desktop Work at launch; local-file Work remains local.
implementation_backlog.verification: Desktop migration article documents the launch boundary.
implementation_backlog.recommendation: Label task origin and synchronization scope; avoid presenting a misleading universal task list.

implementation_backlog.issue: Atlas retires August 9; bookmarks, open tabs, and history do not auto-transfer.
implementation_backlog.recommendation: Provide a time-bounded migration checklist, export status, and explicit non-transfer warning.

implementation_backlog.issue: Reflect is documented only on web and desktop.
implementation_backlog.verification: Reflect help article entry path excludes mobile.
implementation_backlog.recommendation: Do not render a native mobile Reflect dashboard until shipped; optionally deep-link to web.

implementation_backlog.issue: Cowork live artifact creation is desktop-only in the parity table.
implementation_backlog.recommendation: Use preview/download states on non-desktop surfaces and hide unsupported live-edit actions.

implementation_backlog.issue: July 14 search is confirmed on web/iOS/Android, not explicitly on the new desktop shell.
implementation_backlog.verification: Release notes list only those three surfaces.
implementation_backlog.recommendation: Feature-detect desktop search scope rather than assuming launch-day parity.

implementation_backlog.issue: New group-chat creation/joining is retired; existing groups remain temporarily accessible.
implementation_backlog.recommendation: Remove create/invite affordances and add read-only/retirement states to existing conversations.

implementation_backlog.issue: GPT-Live-1 launch path does not support video or screen sharing.
implementation_backlog.recommendation: Keep these actions hidden/disabled in GPT-Live-1 and explain legacy Advanced Voice availability where relevant.

implementation_backlog.issue: Neither company publishes the internal core app token set. OpenAI’s public Apps SDK guidelines are for embedded apps.
implementation_backlog.verification: Official screenshots plus developer guidelines; no core token package found.
implementation_backlog.recommendation: Create semantic internal tokens and annotate inferred values with screenshot/build provenance.

implementation_backlog.issue: Behavior is documented, but no first-party July Android screenshot establishes exact card/chip/composer parity.
implementation_backlog.verification: App store and Cowork help without Android visual reference.
implementation_backlog.recommendation: Run direct build capture before pixel-parity acceptance.

implementation_backlog.issue: Official language says extension or sidebar “where available”; rollout presentation may vary.
implementation_backlog.recommendation: Use capability detection and document toolbar/desktop-bridge fallback.

implementation_backlog.issue: Current public sources establish features but do not publish component-level mobile design tokens.
implementation_backlog.verification: Store listings and selective official imagery.
